```{r}
library(ISLR)
data(Auto)
head(Auto)
dim(Auto)
```
The Auto dataset contains 7 quantitative variables(mpg, cylinders, displacement, horsepower,weight and year)
and 2 qualitative variables(origin and name).

```{r}
advertising<-read.csv("Advertising.csv")
head(advertising)
dim(advertising)
```
The Advertising datatset contains all quantitative variables. It contains the advertising budgets for
TV, radio and newspapers and the sales figures.
